verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline as the dominant element and the CTA prominent at top right. But the SOLSTICE logo is shrunk to a faint, illegible smudge, the 'Limited Summer Release' eyebrow is gone, the body copy is jammed into a narrow 6-line column, and the legal text and 'Ships late June' are unreadably tiny and crammed beside the button. B breaks the hierarchy: the headline is tiny and no bigger than the body copy, the eyebrow and CTA drop to the bottom row below the message, the legal block is as large as the body copy and takes the centre-right, and the logo is clipped and illegible at the far right edge.
